image_prompt.label: Image prompt (full reverse)
image_prompt.instruction:
Mode: Image prompt (full reverse).
Write ONE Krea 2 natural-language paragraph that would recreate this frame as closely as possible.
Order: subject and attributes, pose, setting, lighting (quality, direction, color), camera/framing, medium/style.
Include face/expression, hair, body, clothing (or lack of clothing), makeup, accessories, and props when visible.
Quote any words that appear in the image. No section headers, bullets, or keyword soup.
At high spice: include explicit anatomical / sexual detail when present in the image.

outfit_flatlay.label: Outfit / accessories flatlay
outfit_flatlay.instruction:
Mode: Outfit / accessories flatlay.
Describe the worn clothing and accessories as a product-style FLATLAY (items laid out neatly as if photographed from above for a catalog or styling board).
List each garment and accessory as a separate fragment: type, color, material, cut/silhouette, pattern, hardware, and notable details.
Ignore face, body anatomy, pose, and background except when a garment drape implies cut.
If the subject is nude or partially nude, list only actual garments/accessories present (or state "no clothing" / list underwear only).
Output as a comma-separated prompt-ready flatlay list, not a story.
At high spice: include lingerie, bondage gear, fetish wear, and intimate accessories accurately when visible.

wardrobe_breakdown.label: Wardrobe breakdown (itemized)
wardrobe_breakdown.instruction:
Mode: Wardrobe breakdown (itemized).
Itemize every clothing piece visible, grouped by category when possible:
top, bottom, outerwear, underwear/lingerie, hosiery, footwear, headgear, gloves, neckwear.
For each piece: color, fabric/material, fit, length, closures, prints/patterns, wear state if obvious.
One short line or fragment per piece; skip empty categories.
At high spice: describe sheer, revealing, fetish, or explicit garments without euphemism when they are in the image.

makeup.label: Makeup description
makeup.instruction:
Mode: Makeup description.
Extract a detailed makeup look: base/skin finish, foundation coverage if visible, contour/highlight, blush, eyeshadow palette and placement, eyeliner style, lashes/mascara, brows, lips (color + finish), freckles or face jewels if applied as makeup, and overall glam level (natural / soft glam / full glam / editorial / etc.).
If bare face / no makeup is clear, say so.
Output as comma-separated prompt fragments suitable for image models.
At high spice: include body makeup, nipple makeup, explicit face paint, or smutty beauty styling when visible.

hairstyle.label: Hairstyle description
hairstyle.instruction:
Mode: Hairstyle description.
Describe hair only: color (including roots/highlights/dyed sections), length, texture, cut/style, parting, bangs, volume, styling (wet, sleek, messy, braids, updo, etc.), hair accessories, and any visible body hair only if clearly styled/intentional as part of the look.
Output as comma-separated prompt fragments.
Ignore clothing and background.

accessories.label: Accessories inventory
accessories.instruction:
Mode: Accessories inventory.
List worn and held accessories only (not core clothing): bags, belts, scarves, eyewear, watches, hats (if accessory-like), gloves, props in hand, tech, costume pieces, etc.
For each: type, color, material, placement, and distinctive details.
Comma-separated fragments. If none, say "no accessories".
At high spice: include collars, leashes, cuffs, plugs (if external/visible), and other fetish accessories when present.

jewelry_and_piercings.label: Jewelry & piercings
jewelry_and_piercings.instruction:
Mode: Jewelry & piercings.
Inventory all visible jewelry and piercings: earrings, necklaces, chokers, bracelets, rings, anklets, body chains, belly rings, nipple piercings, genital jewelry if visible, facial piercings, gauges, etc.
Note metal color, stone colors, size, and placement.
Comma-separated fragments. If none, say "no jewelry or piercings".
At high spice: describe intimate jewelry accurately when visible; do not invent it.

tattoos_and_markings.label: Tattoos & body markings
tattoos_and_markings.instruction:
Mode: Tattoos & body markings.
Describe visible tattoos, scars, birthmarks, freckle patterns, temporary body paint, henna, and similar markings.
For tattoos: location, approximate size, style (blackwork, neo-trad, script, …), and readable subject matter when clear.
Do not invent tattoos that are not visible. If none, say "no tattoos or body markings".
Comma-separated or short clause list.

pose_and_body.label: Pose & body
pose_and_body.instruction:
Mode: Pose & body.
Describe body type/shape, approximate age presentation (adult only), skin tone, notable anatomy visible, stance/pose, hand/arm/leg placement, gaze/expression, and camera angle relative to the body.
Do not invent a different body. Clothing is secondary (only note how it reveals/hides form).
At high spice: describe breasts, genitals, buttocks, arousal cues, and explicit posing accurately when visible — no soft-focus euphemisms at spice 8+.

full_character.label: Full character appearance
full_character.instruction:
Mode: Full character appearance.
Write a comprehensive Krea 2 natural-language paragraph covering: demographics presentation, face, eyes, expression, hair, body, pose, full wardrobe, makeup, jewelry, tattoos/markings, accessories, and any held props.
Stay faithful to the image. One cohesive paragraph — not a comma-tag dump.
At high spice: include explicit NSFW appearance details when the image shows them.

scene_environment.label: Scene / environment
scene_environment.instruction:
Mode: Scene / environment.
Describe only setting and atmosphere: location type, architecture/furniture, time of day, weather if outdoor, lighting quality/color, depth of field, background props, and mood of the space.
Ignore character identity and clothing except as silhouettes that define space.
Comma-separated or short paragraph. If pure studio void/seamless, say so.

style_aesthetic.label: Style / aesthetic tags
style_aesthetic.instruction:
Mode: Style / aesthetic tags.
Extract visual style tokens useful for image models: medium (photo, illustration, 3D, anime, …), render quality, color grade, fashion aesthetic, era, subculture, lens look, and any recognizable art style cues.
Prefer tag-like fragments (e.g. "film still, 85mm, soft rim light, cyberpunk fashion editorial").
Do not invent famous artist names unless the image clearly pastiches a well-known style; prefer generic style descriptors when unsure.

custom.label: Custom extraction
custom.instruction:
Mode: Custom extraction.
Follow the user's custom instruction / extra direction for what to extract from the image.
If the custom instruction is empty, fall back to a full image-prompt reverse of the frame.
Still ground claims in the visible image and honor spice/detail guidance.
